ThingDef.label: badzaar pistol
ThingDef.description: A cheap, rough copy of the kwazaari pistol, made from a mix of solar and kwazaar materials. Less accurate and less powerful, but easy to produce for Badzaari raiders.

ThingDef.label: badzaar rifle
ThingDef.description: A mass-produced Badzaari rifle, made from a mix of solar and kwazaar materials. Less accurate and less powerful than the kwazaari version, but easy to produce for Badzaari raiders.

ThingDef.label: badzaar sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: A long-range Badzaari sniper rifle, made from a mix of solar and kwazaar materials. Less accurate and less powerful than the kwazaari version, but easy to produce for Badzaari raiders.

ThingDef.label: badzaar LMG
ThingDef.description: A Badzaari light machine gun, made from a mix of solar and kwazaar materials. Less accurate and less powerful than the kwazaari version, but easy to produce for Badzaari raiders.

ThingDef.label: badzaar shotgun
ThingDef.description: A Badzaari shotgun, made from a mix of solar and kwazaar materials. Less accurate and less powerful than the kwazaari version, but easy to produce for Badzaari raiders.

ThingDef.label: badzaari plate harness
ThingDef.description: A bulky, hastily assembled powered armor shell hammered from Kwazaari alloys. It is brutally heavy, simple to build, and highly protective, but slows the wearer to a crawl.

ThingDef.label: badzaari plated helm
ThingDef.description: A crude but effective helm plated with Kwazaari alloy slabs. Heavy and rough, yet hard to crack.
